name: Arusha National Park
tagline: Colobus monkeys, Mount Meru and walking safaris
intro: Just 45 minutes from Arusha town, this small park offers walking safaris, canoeing on the Momella Lakes and views of both Mount Meru and Kilimanjaro on clear days.
It is perfect for a short day trip or for acclimatising before a Mount Meru or Kilimanjaro trek.
metaTitle: Arusha National Park Day Trip | Walking Safari | Glad Of Africa
metaDescription: Day trips and walking safaris in Arusha National Park, 45 minutes from town. Colobus monkeys, Momella Lakes and Mount Meru views.
